snippet.title: Obscurite Magie 3: The Divine Stones - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Cialis of the Royal Knights of Alzario is ambushed by an evil group of heretical fanatics that call themselves Regalus. Backed into a corner and on the verge of defeat, she has no choice but to form a pact with the spirit named Myuei to fend off the heretical fanatics.
